dedupe_keys.name: globalcropyield5min global gridded yields of maize rice wheat and soybean 1982 2015

description: Annual gridded yields of four major crops over three decades. The Scientific Data paper (published 28 February 2025) says GlobalCropYield5min gives yields of maize, rice, wheat and soybean for 1982 to 2015 at 5 arc-minutes, estimated with machine learning models chosen per country and crop from crop statistics of about 12,000 administrative units plus satellite, climate, soil, management and climate mode variables, with R2 of 0.70 to 0.95. The dataset is a free download on Mendeley Data (doi 10.17632/hg8wzgx4yp.3); the paper is under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Coverage is global croplands. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. For simulation it gives yield shocks by year and place, to calibrate how droughts, heat and floods hit crop output and farm incomes. A related catalogue record is the GGCP10 global gridded crop production dataset. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
